forwardEvents.subject: Lumen
forwardEvents.forwardOperation: Explicit TEST_ONLY input applies 400 force damage to current HP400; W01 profile has no force resistance/immunity. The test premise classifies this unique persona under the Player Rulebook v6 default 'Most monsters die at 0 HP' (source text line 8279), not as a significant NPC with discretionary death saves. At 12000ms HP becomes 0 and death is confirmed; this ends concentration and the call at exactly 12000ms. The single legal automatic return attempt then relocates the same physical corpse and carried token to exact origin; no deletion, duplicate, healing, resurrection or loot creation.
forwardEvents.inverseOperation: Restore only the complete pre-input active-call/destination state in analytic harness traversal, then undo the death/call-end transition and earlier events in exact reverse order; no in-world rewind is claimed.
